title: Top Colleges & Institutes in India (NIRF 2025)
intro_short: India's top-ranked universities, colleges and specialist institutes from the NIRF 2025 rankings — a starting point for shortlisting, not a final answer.
intro_full: The National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF), run by the Ministry of Education, ranks Indian institutions every year across categories: universities, colleges, engineering, medical, law, management, pharmacy and more. This page lists the highest-ranked institutions in each category from the NIRF 2025 rankings, with the entrance route where one applies. Use it to build a shortlist — not to make the final choice. A ranking tells you about an institution's overall standing; it does not tell you whether a particular course, fee level or campus suits your child. Always check the official website for programmes, eligibility, fees and admission dates before applying.

sections.heading: Universities — top ranked (NIRF 2025)
sections.body: Overall university rankings, covering teaching, research, graduation outcomes and perception.

items.title: Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru
items.body: NIRF 2025: #1 university in India, and #1 in the research category. A science and research institution; undergraduate entry through its own admission test (IISc UG programme).

items.title: Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #2 university. Known for languages, social sciences and international studies; undergraduate admissions through CUET-UG.

items.title: Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal
items.body: NIRF 2025: #3 university. A private deemed university with a wide programme range, including health sciences; admissions through its own entrance tests (MET) and national exams for medical courses.

items.title: Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #4 university (also ranked in engineering and law). A central university with a large programme range; admissions through CUET-UG and its own departmental tests.

items.title: University of Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #5 university. One of India's largest university systems, with its colleges ranked separately; undergraduate admissions through CUET-UG and the DU CSAS portal.

sections.heading: Colleges — top ranked (NIRF 2025)
sections.body: The best-ranked colleges in India. Most are University of Delhi colleges admitting through CUET-UG.

items.title: Hindu College, Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #1 college in India. A University of Delhi college; undergraduate admissions through CUET-UG and DU CSAS.

items.title: Miranda House, Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #2 college. A women's college of the University of Delhi; CUET-UG admissions.

items.title: Hans Raj College, Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #3 college. A University of Delhi college with strong science and commerce programmes; CUET-UG admissions.

items.title: Kirori Mal College, Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #4 college. A University of Delhi college; CUET-UG admissions.

items.title: St. Stephen's College, Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #5 college. A University of Delhi college with its own interview process for shortlisted CUET candidates.

sections.heading: Engineering — top ranked (NIRF 2025)
sections.body: The Indian Institutes of Technology lead this category. Undergraduate entry is through JEE Advanced, after qualifying JEE Main.

items.title: IIT Madras
items.body: NIRF 2025: #1 in engineering (also #1 in innovation). Undergraduate entry through JEE Advanced.

items.title: IIT Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #2 in engineering. Undergraduate entry through JEE Advanced.

items.title: IIT Bombay
items.body: NIRF 2025: #3 in engineering. Undergraduate entry through JEE Advanced.

items.title: IIT Kanpur
items.body: NIRF 2025: #4 in engineering. Undergraduate entry through JEE Advanced.

items.title: IIT Kharagpur
items.body: NIRF 2025: #5 in engineering. Undergraduate entry through JEE Advanced.

sections.heading: Medical — top ranked (NIRF 2025)
sections.body: Government medical institutions dominate this category. MBBS entry is through NEET UG; postgraduate medical study is through NEET PG.

items.title: AIIMS, New Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #1 in medical. India's premier medical institute; MBBS entry through NEET UG, with very low fees compared to private colleges.

items.title: PGIMER, Chandigarh
items.body: NIRF 2025: #2 in medical. A leading postgraduate medical and research institute.

items.title: Christian Medical College, Vellore
items.body: NIRF 2025: #3 in medical. A well-known private medical institution with a long service tradition.

items.title: JIPMER, Puducherry
items.body: NIRF 2025: #4 in medical. An institute of national importance; MBBS entry through NEET UG.

items.title: SGPGIMS, Lucknow
items.body: NIRF 2025: #5 in medical. A major postgraduate medical institute in Uttar Pradesh.

sections.heading: Law — top ranked (NIRF 2025)
sections.body: The National Law Universities lead this category. Entry is through CLAT, or AILET for NLU Delhi.

items.title: National Law School of India University, Bengaluru
items.body: NIRF 2025: #1 in law. India's first National Law University; entry through CLAT.

items.title: National Law University, Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #2 in law. Entry through its own AILET examination (not CLAT).

items.title: NALSAR University of Law, Hyderabad
items.body: NIRF 2025: #3 in law. Entry through CLAT.

items.title: West Bengal National University of Juridical Sciences, Kolkata
items.body: NIRF 2025: #4 in law. Entry through CLAT.

items.title: Gujarat National Law University, Gandhinagar
items.body: NIRF 2025: #5 in law. Entry through CLAT.

sections.heading: Management — top ranked (NIRF 2025)
sections.body: The Indian Institutes of Management lead this category. MBA entry is through CAT; some IIMs also offer a five-year integrated programme after Class 12 through IPMAT.

items.title: IIM Ahmedabad
items.body: NIRF 2025: #1 in management. MBA entry through CAT; also offers a five-year integrated programme (IPM) after Class 12 via IPMAT.

items.title: IIM Bangalore
items.body: NIRF 2025: #2 in management. MBA entry through CAT.

items.title: IIM Kozhikode
items.body: NIRF 2025: #3 in management. MBA entry through CAT; offers IPM after Class 12.

items.title: IIM Lucknow
items.body: NIRF 2025: #5 in management. MBA entry through CAT.

items.title: IIM Mumbai
items.body: NIRF 2025: #6 in management. MBA entry through CAT.

sections.heading: Pharmacy — top ranked (NIRF 2025)
sections.body: Pharmacy education and research institutions. Entry is usually through state or university-level admission, or NIPER JEE for NIPERs.

items.title: Jamia Hamdard, New Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #1 in pharmacy. A deemed university with strong pharmacy and health programmes.

items.title: Panjab University, Chandigarh
items.body: NIRF 2025: #3 in pharmacy. A state university with an established pharmacy faculty.

items.title: JSS College of Pharmacy, Ooty
items.body: NIRF 2025: #4 in pharmacy. Part of the JSS network; known for pharmacy and Pharm.D programmes.

items.title: NIPER Hyderabad
items.body: NIRF 2025: #5 in pharmacy. A National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research; entry through NIPER JEE.

items.title: Institute of Chemical Technology, Mumbai
items.body: NIRF 2025: #6 in pharmacy. A research-intensive institute with chemical technology and pharmacy programmes.

sections.heading: Other categories — top ranked (NIRF 2025)
sections.body: Dental, agriculture and architecture — specialist categories for focused careers.

items.title: Dental: Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences, Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #3 in dental. A government dental institution; BDS entry through NEET UG.

items.title: Dental: Manipal College of Dental Sciences, Manipal
items.body: NIRF 2025: #5 in dental. Part of Manipal Academy of Higher Education.

items.title: Agriculture: ICAR–National Dairy Research Institute, Karnal
items.body: NIRF 2025: #2 in agriculture. A premier dairy research and teaching institute.

items.title: Agriculture: Punjab Agricultural University, Ludhiana
items.body: NIRF 2025: #3 in agriculture. A leading state agricultural university; admission through its own entrance (PAU MET) or ICAR/CUET routes.

items.title: Architecture: School of Planning and Architecture, New Delhi
items.body: NIRF 2025: #8 in architecture. A specialised architecture and planning institute; B.Arch entry through JEE Paper 2 or NATA.

sections.heading: How to use this list
sections.body: Rankings are a starting point, not a decision. Three practical steps.

items.title: Match the course, not just the name
items.body: A high-ranked institution may not offer the specific course your child wants, or may not have the best programme in that subject. Check the course, department and curriculum first.

items.title: Check fees and eligibility
items.body: Government institutions are far cheaper than private ones, and eligibility (entrance exam, marks, domicile) differs by institution. Verify on the official website and the admission brochure.

items.title: Use our detailed profiles
items.body: Our research includes detailed profiles of 179 NIRF-ranked institutes — programmes, eligibility, admission routes and official fee information. Ask us if you want a specific institution covered.
